description: Cloud-based data storage and analytics platform providing data warehousing and data lakes
auth_notes: Supports OAuth, key-pair authentication (JWT), and workload identity federation (AWS, Azure, GCP, OIDC).
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a self-serve trial account, which provides API and database access.
api_notes: Offers a SQL REST API for executing queries, managing deployments, and handling transactions, alongside extensive SDKs, drivers, and CLI tools.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Snowflake as of current data; only community-driven integrations exist.
rationale: Snowflake provides a fully documented SQL REST API and robust developer tools, but requires signing up for a trial or paid account before API credentials can be provisioned.

evidence.note: Documents OAuth, key-pair authentication (JWT), and workload identity federation.
Provides options to sign up for a trial account to get started.
Describes the Snowflake SQL REST API capabilities for querying and managing deployments.
